leads.name: The Oak at the Randenbroek Pond
leads.location_hint: Park Randenbroek, behind the house on the bank of the big pond, Amersfoort
leads.source: IVN Amersfoort, local tree expert's list 'Ancient Trees Amersfoort', October 2026 (mailed 2026-10-19)
leads.reason: Top candidate. The expert's list calls it the oldest: 'Park Randenbroek op terras aan de grote vijver', planted 1650 (376 years). The LRMB register (nr 1677723) puts the same spot's oak at 1860-1870, visitable, municipal. Two ages two centuries apart: publish both, the expert's as a local estimate. Anchors a Randenbroek walk (beech, plane, yew below).

leads.name: Other Plantsoen-Oost trees on the expert's list
leads.source: IVN Amersfoort, local tree expert's list 'Ancient Trees Amersfoort', October 2026 (mailed 2026-10-19)
leads.reason: Expert's list, 1900 to 1931: American lime, horse chestnut, plane and catalpa near the St Andriesstraat; plane and weeping beech behind Binnen de Veste; Crimean lime behind the Waltoren; black alder and honey locust by the old wall; sycamore by the Mariënhof (1920); black walnut by the Stadsring path (1930). Under 100 years mostly: depth for a walk, not pages.
